subject: general
question: In a certain code language, AMAZON is coded as 140 and BRAZIL is coded as 136. How will GERMANY be coded in the same language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba1da5a551c84945b9af035f1db238af04e6ae3b72f1a63cb6af10db305a1d1f.png] 

**Sum of alphabet positional value × 2.**

 
• AMAZON is coded as 140

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259c89d2a6030db2a12ebdae6fccf9196da7cfef7d6d28cda9a1f6542998d13a.png] 

= (1 + 13 + 1 + 26 + 15 + 14) × 2

= 70 × 2

= 140

And,

 
• BRAZIL is coded as 136.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf282904c0ab240e129d50ae6dbab374ceb82d61fbbe801d068e77264550ef7d.png] 

= (2 + 18 + 1 + 26 + 9 + 12) × 2

= 68 × 2

= 136

Similarly,

 
• **GERMANY will be coded as :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa3db2ced19b8e2d97b2e54c27f3b52f2d61fedfdb7c15a4cc34ac85445f1785.png] 

**= (7 + 5 + 18 + 13 + 1 + 14 + 25) × 2**

**= 83 × 2**

**= 166**

Hence, the correct answer is **"166".**
